root_cause.text: The loop in `imx8m_blk_ctrl_remove()` lacks a proper termination condition comparing the loop counter `i` to the maximum number of domains, resulting in an out-of-bounds access of the `bc->domains` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the loop condition was corrected from `for (i = 0; bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)` to `for (i = 0; i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)` to prevent out-of-range access of `bc->domains[i]`.
